nodes.label: Knowledge Distillation Must Account for What It Loses
nodes.author: Wenshuo Wang
nodes.rationale: Position paper arguing that knowledge distillation evaluation must account for off-metric capability losses beyond primary task scores, proposing Distillation Loss Statement for accountable reporting.

nodes.label: Distillation Loss Statement
nodes.rationale: Proposed reporting template for knowledge distillation documenting deployment context, critical off-metric capabilities, preservation targets, observed losses, and deployment implications.

nodes.label: Off-Metric Distillation Losses Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy of 9 capability dimensions where students diverge from teachers: predictive-distribution, representation/relation, capability-boundary, privacy/memorization, calibration/abstention, process/on-policy, grounding/provenance, safety-boundary, long-tail/diversity.

nodes.label: Lossy Projection Framework for Distillation
nodes.rationale: Reframes knowledge distillation as projection onto subset of teacher observables, making visible which capabilities are unconstrained or weakly constrained.

nodes.label: Retention Assumption in Distillation
nodes.rationale: Hidden assumption that primary metric retention implies preserved teacher capability; shown to be logically unwarranted without explicit off-metric capability measurement.

nodes.label: Scenario-Specific Preservation Targets
nodes.rationale: Context-dependent preservation targets for 8 distillation scenarios (reasoning, code agents, RAG, domain assistants, privacy-sensitive, safety, synthetic-data, on-device).
